references.text: The Kohathites' responsibility for the holy items in the tabernacle is first introduced here, including the ark, the table, the lampstand, and the altars.
The Kohathites were given no carts because they were to carry the holy items on their shoulders.
A description of how Aaron and his sons were to cover the holy items before the Kohathites could carry them.
Warning that the Kohathites must not look at the holy things, not even for a moment, or they will die.
Uzzah died when he touched the ark, fulfilling the warning in Numbers that those who touch the holy items will die.
The men of Beth-Shemesh were struck down because they looked into the Lord's ark, demonstrating the consequence of profaning what is holy.
The poles used to carry the ark were always to remain in its rings so that no one would need to touch the ark itself.
David confirms that only the Levites should carry God's ark, in accordance with the instructions given in Numbers.
The Levites carried God's ark on their shoulders using the poles, just as Moses had commanded according to the word of the Lord.
